episode_row: premature "not entered" DM on a deferred, undelivered DD

commits.subject: fix(cli): gate check-pick-entered on commit/lock state; report submission cutoff
commits.body:
check-pick-entered treated the mere existence of {date}.json as "a pick Eric was
told to enter," but the scheduler rewrites that file all day with previews/
projections, and an undelivered pick can be deferred (and its file deleted)
minutes later. On 2026-07-06 this fired a premature "not entered" DM for a
deferred double-down 16 min before the scheduler deleted the pick.

Gate on the same commit signal check-results uses — is_scoreable_commit
(decision.json scoreable, with a pick_was_delivered fallback) — placed before
the window check and any contest-account fetch. This covers the delivered /
private_locked / locked_unconfirmed commit states (all write scoreable=True) and
stays silent for previews/deferred picks. Using pick_was_delivered alone would
have suppressed legitimate alerts for private_locked and locked_unconfirmed
(Codex review).

Also fix the DM countdown to report time to the real submission deadline (first
pitch − 5 min), not to first pitch.

Tests: undelivered-preview-in-window → no DM/marker; countdown shows minutes to
cutoff. _save_pick gains a `delivered` flag (defaults committed).

commits.subject: fix(cli): exclude un-submittable final 5 min from entry-check window (Codex review)
commits.body:
Pre-merge Codex review found the DM used the first-pitch − 5 cutoff for its
countdown while the firing window still ran to first pitch — so a run inside the
final 5 minutes would nag "Fix it now!" with a negative countdown for a pick that
can no longer be submitted. Raise the window's lower bound to the 5-min cutoff.

Also close the review's test gap: the positive tests only exercised the
pick_was_delivered fallback, not the decision.json gate. Add coverage for a
scoreable decision-record commit (no delivery flags → still alerts) and a
skip-day decision (scoreable=false → silent), plus the inside-cutoff case.

Deferred findings (documented in the audit doc): is_scoreable_commit is only
fallback-robust for private_locked/locked_unconfirmed if the best-effort
decision.json write failed; load_decision date/action laxity; and the checker
reading {date}.json rather than the decision payload. All narrow / shared-code;
tracked as follow-ups.
